Class SysMLStateMachine.Timer

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.states.SysMLStateMachine.Timer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
Enclosing class:
SysMLStateMachine
public class SysMLStateMachine.Timer extends Object implements Runnable
Timer for generating time events for state machine. The timers are Runnables and "run" in a thread managed by the thread pool of the state machine's context part. The timers are started by calling the state machine's startTimer() operation.

    • Timer

      public Timer(String timerID, DurationMilliseconds initialDelay, DurationMilliseconds period)
      Timer constructor for relative time
      Parameters:
      timerID - The unique identifier of the new timer. (used to identify the timer to stop)
      initialDelay - The initial delay before the first time event
      period - The period between successive time events. A period of 0 indicates a single (one-shot) timer is to be created.

  • Method Details

    • run

      public void run()
      Runnable run() operation. Operation is called at timer's thread execution time. On invocation, it either queues up a SysMLTimeEvent to the eventQueue or, if this is not an asynchronous state machine, simply invokes the state-machine's onEvent() event-handling operation.
      Specified by:
      run in interface Runnable
